lane.title: Larkspoon Notes, Google Play, US: store page
lane.scope: One Android app, Larkspoon Notes, on Google Play in the US: its listing text, keywords, screenshots and a test plan, one stage at a time. You approve and publish; we never touch the Play Console. No App Store, no other country, no paid installs.
lane.why: installs = store impressions x page conversion; both unknown until the Play Console export arrives; the page and its keywords are the free levers
lane.gauge: stage reached (S01-S08) and what it waits on; weekly target: one stage moved or its customer ask answered
lane.done: an S08 report has passed its check and reached the customer and the roadmap is decided
lane.pause: no approved change live 2 weeks after the date the customer gives, or console data is withdrawn

score.why: search and page are the main route for a free app; standard methods, no published effect size; nobody named to publish yet; changes can be live in days

words: Open one lane, aso/store-pages for Larkspoon Notes on Play US, rank 1; plan in work/plan/G1.md
